newsitem.title: HUNGARY: ESTONIAN PRESIDENT MERI BEGINS VISIT TO HUNGARY.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIAN PRESIDENT MERI BEGINS VISIT TO HUNGARY.

text.p: Estonian President Lennart Meri began a three-day state visit to Hungary on Tuesday, the first by an Estonian head of state since his country regained independence from the former Soviet Union in 1990.

The visit comes as the two countries, both of which have applied to join NATO, await the alliance's Madrid summit next month at which a decision on the alliance's first new members from the former Soviet bloc are to be announced.
Hungary is expected to be among the first group while Estonia, along with the other Baltic States of Latvia and Lithuania are likely to be asked to wait, for fear of upsetting neighbouring Russia.
Meri is to hold talks with his Hungarian counterpart Arpad Goncz and will later address Hungary's parliament. REUTER
